scope: All three previously held items Q095–097, a single Part 4 talk

group.title: A restaurant follow-up call
group.passage:
F1: Good afternoon. This is Grace from the Cedar Kitchen, calling about your Saturday lunch. You wanted the upstairs room so your team could run a short slide show. The lift to that room will be out of service. If anyone needs step-free access, we can set up a screen in the garden room instead. Both rooms have the same menu.

I see that you’re bringing a cake. We can keep it in the fridge, but the kitchen staff can only take it in before eleven. Your friend is due at eleven thirty. If she can’t come earlier, please ask her to keep the cake with her until you’re ready to serve it.

One more thing: we can put food on one bill and drinks on another, but we can’t bill guests individually. Tell me which of those two bills should go to your office.
group.passageZh:
您好，我是雪松餐廳的 Grace，來電是想跟您確認週六午餐的安排。貴團隊原本想訂樓上的包廂，這樣就能播一小段投影片。通往包廂的電梯將暫停使用。如果有人需要無階梯通行，我們可以改在花園包廂架設投影幕。兩個包廂的菜單都一樣。

我看到您有備註會帶蛋糕來。我們可以代為冷藏，但廚房人員只能在十一點前收下蛋糕。您的朋友原定十一點半到。如果她沒辦法提早來，請她自己先保管，到你們要吃蛋糕時再拿出來。

還有一件事：我們可以把餐點和飲料分成兩張帳單，但不能替每位來賓個別開帳單。這兩張帳單中，請告訴我哪張要寄給貴公司。

turns.text:
Good afternoon. This is Grace from the Cedar Kitchen, calling about your Saturday lunch. You wanted the upstairs room so your team could run a short slide show. The lift to that room will be out of service. If anyone needs step-free access, we can set up a screen in the garden room instead. Both rooms have the same menu.

questions.prompt: What would let the group keep its slide show while making the lunch accessible without stairs?
questions.promptZh: 哪個安排能保留投影片簡報，也讓無法走樓梯的人參加午餐？

options.text: Replacing the slide show with a talk
options.zh: 改成口頭報告，不播投影片
options.whyZh: 花園包廂可以架設投影幕，因此不用放棄播放投影片。

options.text: Moving the lunch and slide show to the garden room
options.zh: 把午餐和投影片簡報都改到花園包廂
options.whyZh: 樓上包廂的電梯暫停使用；花園包廂不必走樓梯，也能架設投影幕，所以既可用餐，也能保留投影片簡報。

options.text: Asking the kitchen to change the menu
options.whyZh: 兩間包廂的菜單相同；要改的是用餐地點，而不是餐點。

options.text: Using the lift after the meal
options.whyZh: 電梯將暫停使用，沒有說用完餐後就能恢復。

questions.explanationZh: 樓上包廂的電梯暫停使用；花園包廂不必走樓梯，也能架設投影幕，所以既可用餐，也能保留投影片簡報。
questions.evidence: The lift to that room will be out of service. If anyone needs step-free access, we can set up a screen in the garden room instead.

vocabulary.note: 表示前往該處不必走樓梯。

questions.prompt: What would allow the restaurant to refrigerate the cake?
questions.promptZh: 怎麼做才能請餐廳代為冷藏蛋糕？

options.text: Serving the cake before the meal
options.whyZh: 用餐或吃蛋糕的時間不影響廚房收件；廚房只在十一點前收。

options.text: Having the friend hand the cake to staff at 11:30
options.zh: 請朋友在上午 11 點半把蛋糕交給廚房人員
options.whyZh: 上午 11 點半已超過廚房上午 11 點的收件截止時間。

options.text: Moving the lunch to a later time
options.whyZh: 延後用餐不會延後廚房收蛋糕的時間。

options.text: Having the friend deliver the cake at 10:50
options.zh: 請朋友在上午 10 點 50 分送蛋糕來
options.whyZh: 上午 10 點 50 分比原定抵達時間早，也在廚房上午 11 點的收件截止前，所以可以交給廚房冷藏。

questions.explanationZh: 上午 10 點 50 分比原定抵達時間早，也在廚房上午 11 點的收件截止前，所以可以交給廚房冷藏。
questions.evidence: the kitchen staff can only take it in before eleven. Your friend is due at eleven thirty.

vocabulary.note: 這裡指原先安排的抵達時間，不是廚房收件截止時間。

questions.prompt: The office is paying for food only. Which billing request meets the office’s requirement and can be fulfilled by the restaurant?
questions.promptZh: 公司只支付餐點費用。哪項帳單安排既符合公司的要求，也是餐廳能做到的？

options.text: Send one bill for all the food to the office.
options.zh: 把所有餐點併成一張帳單寄給公司。
options.whyZh: 餐廳能按餐點和飲料分開結帳，因此可把全體餐點列在同一張帳單上寄給公司，不包含飲料。

options.text: Send a separate food bill for each guest to the office.
options.zh: 每位來賓的餐點各開一張帳單寄給公司。
options.whyZh: 餐廳能依費用類別分帳，但不能替每位來賓分開開帳單。

options.text: Combine food and drinks on a single bill for the office.
options.zh: 把餐點與飲料列在同一張帳單寄給公司。
options.whyZh: 即便能合併，公司也只支付餐點，合併會讓帳單包含公司不負擔的費用。

options.text: Send the drinks bill to the office and let guests pay for food individually.
options.zh: 把飲料帳單寄給公司，並讓來賓各自支付餐點。
options.whyZh: 顛倒了公司負擔的費用，而且餐廳不能按人分成多張帳單。

questions.explanationZh: 餐廳能按餐點和飲料分開結帳，因此可把全體餐點列在同一張帳單上寄給公司，不包含飲料。
questions.evidence: we can put food on one bill and drinks on another, but we can’t bill guests individually. Tell me which of those two bills should go to your office.

vocabulary.note: bill 可當動詞，表示向某人開帳單；這裡區分按費用種類與按來賓分帳。

reasoning: Match new room and projector to an access constraint, not menu or lift recovery.
Compare the friend’s planned arrival to the kitchen cutoff, distinct from the meal itself.
Apply office-only food payment to category split and individual-billing prohibition together.
